name: Muskogee HPC data center
status_note: 100 MW HPC data center (Core Scientific) with ~70 MW IT for CoreWeave; Building 1 built but not seen operating (Jun 2026); a second, unleased 82.5 MW building planned for Q4 2027.

construction_start.note: Core Scientific, CoreWeave and Port Muskogee break ground, 18 Nov 2024.
